newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar wraps up at day's highs.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar wraps up at day's highs.

text.p: LIFFE sugar ended firmer on Thursday evening, hanging onto all of the day's gains, traders said.
The May contract closed $2.10 stronger at $310.20 per tonne, the day's high mark, while August wrapped up $1.30 firmer at $307.60.
Short covering had helped the market to rise earlier in the day and it held on well to the higher levels reached, a trader said.
Trading was active although the apparent volume was inflated by switches and trade against actuals. At 1800 GMT total volume was 3,777 lots, of which 1,066 were in May.
